topic: Changes of state, particle arrangement, and energy
key_concepts: Solids have particles tightly packed in a regular pattern
Liquids have particles close together with no regular arrangement
Gases have particles well separated with no regular arrangement
Heating a solid makes its particles vibrate faster
Absorbing thermal energy increases particle kinetic energy
Increased kinetic energy causes particles to move farther apart
Losing thermal energy decreases particle motion and brings particles closer
The six phase changes are melting, freezing, evaporation, condensation, sublimation, and d
Melting is solid to liquid and freezing is liquid to solid
Evaporation is liquid to gas and condensation is gas to liquid
Sublimation is solid to gas and deposition is gas to solid
During evaporation, remaining liquid molecules have lower average kinetic energy
